installation.title: Installations
installation.subtitle: On-premise environments for this customer.
installation.masterKeyAlertBody: The central has generated a new AES-256 key. Copy it immediately to the on-premise server (env CRYPTO_MASTER_KEY) — you can always retrieve it from the installation detail, but it is convenient to do it now.
installation.baseUrlPattern: URL must start with http:// or https://.
installation.baseUrlHint: Must start with http:// or https://.
installation.securitySubtitle: Credentials for the central → on-premise channel.
installation.apiKeyConfiguredHint: Encrypted at rest, not retrievable in plain text.
installation.apiKeyMissingHint: The on-premise server will not be able to authenticate writes until this is set.
installation.rotateApiKeyInfo: Rotates the write API key used by the central to authenticate against the on-prem during configuration pushes. After rotation you must update the key in the on-prem database.
installation.rotateMasterKeyInfo: Rotates the AES-256-GCM key used to encrypt configuration payloads before pushing. After rotation you must update CRYPTO_MASTER_KEY on the on-prem, otherwise previously pushed configurations will no longer be decryptable.
installation.payloadKeyConfiguredHint: Retrievable in plain text to copy to the on-premise server.
installation.payloadKeyMissingHint: Config pushes will fail until the on-premise server and central share the same key.
installation.syncSubtitle: Last config push to this on-premise server.
installation.deleteConfirmMessage: The installation will be deactivated. Products and configurations remain in the archive. Continue?
installation.createIntro: Add an on-premise installation for customer
installation.createApiKeyHint: Encrypted at rest on the central, no longer retrievable in plain text.
installation.createMasterKeyHint: Leave blank to generate a random one; you can retrieve it immediately after.
installation.rotateApiKeyBodyPre: Set the new write API key for installation
installation.rotateApiKeyBodyPost: The key is encrypted at rest on the central and will not be retrievable in plain text: copy it to the on-premise server before saving.
installation.rotateApiKeyError: Unable to update the API key.
installation.rotateMasterKeyResultHint: Copy it immediately to the on-premise server (variable app.crypto.master-key / env CRYPTO_MASTER_KEY) — it is the same key saved encrypted on the central, but viewing it in plain text here is the most convenient opportunity.
installation.rotateMasterKeyWarn: Without this key on the on-premise server, payloads pushed from the central will no longer be decryptable and the push will fail with DRAFT.
installation.rotateMasterKeyFormPre: Generate a new payload master key for
installation.rotateMasterKeyFormHint: Leave blank to have a random one generated by the central, or paste a ready-made AES Base64 32-byte key.
installation.rotateMasterKeyFieldHint: If empty, the central generates a random key.
installation.rotateMasterKeyError: Unable to rotate the payload master key.
installation.showMasterKeyIntroHint: Used by the on-premise server to decrypt config payloads pushed by the central.

config.hint401Title: Product not registered on the on-premise server (401)
config.hint401Body: The product may not yet be present in the tenant table of the on-premise database, or a WRITE API key may be missing. Check in the on-premise DB that the product exists with the corresponding slug and has an active WRITE API key.

config.addEntityTooltip: Add a new entity for this channel
config.noConfig: No configuration saved for this entity.
config.saveDraftWarning: Configuration saved. Push failed — retry with Resync.
config.resyncTooltip: Retry the push of the last active version
config.resyncDraft: Resync failed — the error has been updated.
config.rollbackConfirmMessage: A new active version will be created with the content of v{{version}} and pushed to the on-premise server. Continue?
config.rollbackDraft: Rollback to v{{version}} saved. Push failed — resync.
config.diffRollbackDisabledTooltip: Both versions are identical, rollback not needed.
config.endpointsSubtitle: URLs to call to read the configurations pushed for this channel.
config.endpointsNoEntities: No configurations pushed yet for this channel.
config.docIntro: Configurations are pushed from the central to the on-prem. The client (mobile app, web, totem) reads them directly from the on-prem via REST API.
config.docAuthBody: Every request must include the X-API-Key header with a READ or WRITE key associated to the product (tenant). Keys are managed on the on-prem database.
config.docParamEntity: entity (optional, default: base) — name of the entity to read
config.docResponseBody: The response is a JSON object with a payload field containing the AES-256-GCM encrypted configuration in Base64.
config.docDecryptBody: To decrypt the payload you need the Payload Master Key of the installation, visible (and rotatable) in the Security section of the installation page.
